finding: Filtering to successful runs estimates successful-run cost, not total cost per accepted task.
required_change: Introduce a route/task attempt-chain identity and terminal acceptance, aggregate first attempt, failed attempts, retries, escalation, verification, tool fees and human review before computing accepted-task cost; retain never-accepted chains for failure risk/penalty analysis.
acceptance_test: A fixture with one failed cheap attempt followed by one accepted expensive attempt attributes both costs to the accepted chain, while a never-accepted chain is not silently dropped.

finding: Censored task_success=false records can be treated as ordinary completed failures.
required_change: Separate completed successes, completed failures, censored outcomes and unknown outcomes; add censor exposure/budget fields and use bounds or survival methods only when support permits.
acceptance_test: A censored false record changes censor counts but not the completed-outcome failure denominator.

finding: Validator references included_in_numerical_priors although strict schema forbids it; scripts include all A-C rows.
required_change: Define and enforce a compatible numerical-prior inclusion gate, including the explicit-stratum restriction for class C, in schema, validator and both analysis scripts.
acceptance_test: A class C incompatible record validates only as excluded and cannot enter statistics or baselines.

finding: Leave-one-run-out permits repeated runs of the same task/source to predict each other, and task enrichment keys only on task_id.
required_change: Join tasks by dataset_id plus task_id (and version where available); evaluate by leave-one-source-out or grouped task/source folds with all preprocessing fit inside each training fold.
acceptance_test: No held-out task/source identifier occurs in the training fold and duplicate task IDs across datasets join correctly.

finding: Implemented grouping omits several compatibility dimensions required by the statistical plan.
required_change: Use or explicitly gate on benchmark/version, difficulty, tool profile, reasoning effort, agent count, success criterion, context state, token-accounting definition and price date; never pool merely because dataset/model/framework/domain match.
acceptance_test: Rows differing on an incompatible dimension are separated or explicitly excluded from a comparison.

finding: Cost fields have no currency, scope, price-table ID or component units, while the objective adds heterogeneous resources.
required_change: Represent API/tool monetary cost, human minutes, wall time, subscription quota and failure penalty separately; specify currency and valuation coefficients or retain a vector objective.
acceptance_test: No formula adds dollars, minutes, tokens or quota units without an explicit conversion and date/basis.

finding: Run prompt_tokens scope is ambiguous and input amplification references schema-absent first_request_prompt_tokens.
required_change: Derive first and cumulative request input from linked request records or add explicit first_request_input_tokens and cumulative_prompt_tokens with accounting scope.
acceptance_test: Amplification is null unless compatible first-request and cumulative values are observed and linked.

finding: Cache and tool-burden ratios do not verify shared accounting semantics.
required_change: Require compatible measurement definitions and scopes before division; report denominator coverage and zero-denominator nulls.
acceptance_test: A fixture with incompatible cache/prompt semantics yields null plus a reason, not a ratio.

finding: Clipped ridge predictions are labeled as probability baselines but are not logistic or necessarily calibrated.
required_change: Relabel as linear-probability diagnostic or implement regularized logistic regression; report grouped held-out Brier score, calibration bins and uncertainty.
acceptance_test: Probability output is evaluated only out of group and includes reliability/calibration reporting.

finding: Minimum sample thresholds ignore feature width and regularized/tree errors are in-sample.
required_change: Require adequate events/support relative to effective features, tune only inside training folds, and publish grouped out-of-sample metrics; otherwise leave model untrained.
acceptance_test: A high-dimensional n=12 fixture remains untrained and no in-sample metric is described as calibration.

finding: Median/all-zero imputation conflates unknown, not-applicable and reference-category values.
required_change: Add missingness and applicability indicators, fit imputers within folds, preserve non-applicable capability domains, and define an explicit unknown category.
acceptance_test: MATH not-applicable, MATH unknown and an observed median MATH level encode differently.

finding: The stump omits missing-feature rows from candidate loss and selects/evaluates splits in-sample.
required_change: Assign missing rows through an explicit branch, compare loss on a common row set, enforce defensible leaf support and evaluate on grouped held-out data.
acceptance_test: A mostly-missing feature cannot win merely because its missing rows were excluded from loss.

finding: Missingness and measurement checks omit request cache-write/tool/context fields and most non-token telemetry; relational integrity is unchecked.
required_change: Validate all nullable measured fields, measurement-map keys, unique IDs, run/request/task/source links, request sequence, aggregate reconciliation, censor reason, quality/license gates and applicable cost metadata.
acceptance_test: Fixtures with an unlisted null request token, orphan request, duplicate ID, inconsistent aggregate or undated cost fail validation.

finding: IID run bootstrap understates dependence and p90 has no interval.
required_change: Cluster-bootstrap by task/source where repeated runs are dependent; add uncertainty for p90 and disclose small effective cluster counts.
acceptance_test: Repeated runs of one task count as one resampling cluster and output reports cluster count.

finding: Log-ridge total/cost output estimates a transformed central value, not p90 or arithmetic expected cost; expected_accepted_task_cost_median mixes expectation and median.
required_change: Name conditional medians honestly, use quantile loss for p90, and use a suitable positive-cost mean model or retransformation correction for expected cost.
acceptance_test: Each artifact states estimand, conditioning event and loss; p90 uses held-out pinball loss and expected cost is not a median mislabeled as expectation.

finding: A-C records are pooled without sensitivity by quality or measurement method.
required_change: Report class/measurement mix and repeat key estimates for A-B only versus A-C; do not let C dominate a prior without disclosure.
acceptance_test: Every quantitative table exposes effective n by quality and measurement method.

finding: Retries and escalation are outcomes of a route policy, not only a single model choice.
required_change: Define optimization over feasible policy pi after hard gates, with lower-confidence success constraints, OOD fallback and explicitly valued cost components; catastrophic risk remains a constraint rather than a price tradeoff.
acceptance_test: No feasible route returns human-led/no-route, and an uncertain cheap estimate cannot pass solely on its point success estimate.

finding: Missingness is global and does not distinguish not-collected, unsupported, withheld, structurally inapplicable or unknown.
required_change: Report missingness by dataset/field and reason category, including outcome missingness and failed-trajectory selection.
acceptance_test: A heatmap shows denominator and reason per source rather than treating every null identically.
